div.p: Karakas and Avasthas share no computation. An avastha is a state of a planet (from its longitude / degree / dignity / combustion / associations). A karaka is a significator assignment ("planet X stands for topic Y"). They meet only in synthesis: BPHS / Raman — judge a bhava/topic from house + its lord + its occupants + its karaka, and weigh each of those by its strength & avastha.
